dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted; provenance URLs reject credentials, queries, and fragments. Retained failure text is documented as potentially sensitive evidence.
Entry, replay, and successful persistence use structured info logs without report contents.
File, size, schema, hash, and identity checks precede persistence; errors identify the failing constraint.
Model test context covers writes, replay, conflict, subsequent versions, malformed input, reporter extras, unions, and unsafe provenance.
Same-run identical replay is a no-op, same-run conflict is rejected, and later runs append versions to the retained environment stream.
Input is stat-bounded to 5 MB before allocation and no persistent handles or temporary files are created by the model.
Documentation and fixtures use synthetic example domains and identifiers.
Published arguments and output resources are strict; extensible Playwright envelopes strip extras and metadata uses an explicit primitive union without object coercion.
Evidence has infinite lifetime and bounded version garbage collection matching the retained type.
Append-only evidence recorder, not a CRUD lifecycle model.
No external mutation or authority; the method only validates and persists evidence.
One browser-<environment> stream preserves all active Moment Savor query and workflow consumers.
Replay and stream state are read through readResource.
The 2026.08.24.1 bump includes an identity global-attributes upgrade from the retained no-global-arguments model.
